name: Empujando Juntos
content: Problems and Purpose Empujando Juntos is a collaborative-design project engineering a free-to-use, open source webapp to facilitate discussion processes. The project intends to expand the functionalities of the popular, open-source Pol.is application by building instruments of collective action and group-management, like notifications and event sharing. Once finished, the app will be available for use by both government and civil society organizations as part of a collective deliberation process that combines digital and face-to-face strategies. Background History and Context The project was selected during the event, Collective Intelligence for Democracy .
